claim_ceiling: This register records discoverable candidate sources and known access/rights facts. No live GIS, population, service, public-space or timetable layer has been ingested or qualified by this register.

sources.name: Gauteng City-Region Observatory Data Portal
candidate_layers: South Africa land use/land cover and urban footprint
sources.geography: Gauteng City-Region; per-layer extent must be confirmed
known_facts: Portal lists the candidate subject areas.
Portal states that some datasets download directly, while some lead to landing/menu pages and may require registration.
required_checks: Capture catalogue metadata and direct links per layer
Record rights notice for each data file
Hash source snapshot and retain retrieval date
Confirm exact Johannesburg coverage and boundary vintage

sources.name: GCRO Quality of Life Survey 7 (2023/24)
sources.publisher: GCRO; distributed by DataFirst, University of Cape Town
sources.license: Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 (CC BY 4.0), public-use anonymised dataset as stated by GCRO/DataFirst
sources.geography: Gauteng; ward-representative survey design as documented by GCRO
known_facts: Latest round surfaced in the GCRO/DataFirst catalogue at register creation.
Questionnaire covers transport, services, health, economy, environment, safety, governance and social dimensions.
Survey data have weights and technical documentation that must be used.
unknowns: Exact spatial fields and usable geographic precision in public-use release
Whether any selected variables support Johannesburg-only disaggregation without unacceptable sampling error
required_checks: Read questionnaire, sampling, weighting and fieldwork reports before analysis
Use survey weights and report standard errors/design effects
Do not geocode or publish respondent coordinates
Do not interpret adult respondents as a complete census of all residents

sources.name: Stats SA Ward-level Small Area Population Estimates, 2022
sources.method: Raking / iterative proportional fitting using Census 2011 and Census 2022
known_facts: Stats SA states that spreadsheets, a technical note, ward shapefiles and provincial/district maps are available.
Stats SA warns that very small-area census values can be unstable due to variability, bias and undercount; the release is described as the last lowest-level ward estimate product.
unknowns: Explicit reuse/redistribution licence for each downloadable file
CRS and exact schema for each file
Methodological uncertainty measures and reliability by ward
required_checks: Download technical note, spreadsheets and ward boundaries
Record the 2020 boundary crosswalk and population totals
Preserve age/sex and population-group definitions exactly as published
Do not downscale ward totals to buildings without a separately validated model

sources.name: City of Johannesburg Integrated Spatial Data Platform and Spatial Plan Management System
sources.publisher: City of Johannesburg; Development Planning / Corporate Geo-Informatics / Johannesburg Development Agency
known_facts: City announcement says municipal and municipal-entity spatial data are being consolidated into a web-based repository.
Announcement says the Spatial Plan Management System makes spatial plans accessible online.
unknowns: Per-layer ownership, licence, publication date, effective date and update cadence
Whether a web map layer can be redistributed or only viewed
required_checks: Locate the live platform and its catalogue
Test public access without privileged credentials
Record each layer's metadata and rights
Request permission where export or reuse rights are unclear
Do not scrape access-controlled or restricted information

sources.name: OpenStreetMap road, path, crossing and point-of-interest data
sources.license: Open Database License (ODbL) 1.0; attribution required and share-alike obligations apply to distributed derivative databases
known_facts: OSM data include roads, trails, railway stations and mapped points of interest.
The OSM Foundation requires attribution and clear indication that the data are available under ODbL.
unknowns: Local completeness and positional accuracy by neighborhood and feature class
Missing sidewalks, crossings, informal paths, gates and service locations
required_checks: Use a dated regional extract or replication snapshot; store timestamp and checksum
Retain ODbL attribution and assess database share-alike obligations before distribution
Run topology, connectivity and coverage audits
Ground-truth critical barriers and step-free crossings with safe, consent-based field checks
Do not treat mapped presence or absence as proof that a facility exists or is absent

sources.name: Johannesburg-area public transport schedule feeds (candidate GTFS sources)
sources.publisher: Potentially Rea Vaya, Gautrain, Metrobus and other operators; not yet established
sources.required_standard: GTFS Schedule; GTFS Realtime only where actually published
known_facts: No specific current operator-published feed has been verified in this inventory.
unknowns: Effective dates, last-modified and update cadence
Observed service reliability and accessibility information
required_checks: Locate official operator source, not an unofficial scrape
Validate feed with canonical GTFS validator
Check service dates cover the analysis period
Check stop/route coverage against known services
Capture calendars, exceptions and feed digest
Treat absence of a feed as a data gap; do not synthesize headways from stop locations

minimum_ingestion_contract.privacy_default: No individual survey coordinates, household addresses or person-level mobility traces in the public benchmark
